First full crawl on 24 Nov 2026 in English (run.language en), currency PHP, plain HTTP via pipeline/fetcher.py. Real-Chrome mode was not used (hsbc.com.ph is not in config/real_chrome_hosts.json). The products listing and the compare tool list four open consumer credit cards, all handed in from their product pages: HSBC Live+ Credit Card, HSBC Red Platinum Mastercard, HSBC Premier Travel Card and HSBC Premier Mastercard. The Other credit cards page still shows three products that are currently not available to new customers, all handed in with status no_new_applications from that shared page: HSBC Advance Visa, HSBC Gold Mastercard and HSBC Classic Credit Card. The site menu still names HSBC Gold Visa Cash Back at /credit-cards/products/gold-visa/, which redirects to the products listing and is not in the sitemap or the compare selector, so it was not handed in. The offers hub also names HSBC Platinum Visa Rebate Credit Card as a related product, with no product page on this host. Live+ page text does not state the card network (Visa Digital Concierge is a network service, not proof), so networks is empty and the card has network_not_stated. The annual fee amount is only in a robots-disallowed PDF, so the card also has fee_unclear. Closed cards have no fee amounts on the HTML page (fees PDFs are disallowed) and share one product page. Offers handed in from official hsbc.com.ph pages: Live+ waived annual fees for life (end date not stated), free luggage for Live+ and for Red Platinum (both end 30 November 2026), PHP15,000 cashback for Premier Travel (end date not stated), Hedgren Yuno luggage for Premier Mastercard (21 September to 30 November 2026), and the year-round 3% Caltex fuel rebate. The latest-offers tile 'Get 5% cashback on your travel spending with Live+' ends 30 June 2026 and was left out as expired. The Caltex page also records a finished 2026 raffle (winners announced; not handed in). Most merchant deals sit on offers.hsbc.com.ph (All offers, Red Hot Deals, Mastercard and Visa category listings, instalment partner lists, waived-fees terms PDF, and the expired Live+ travel promo). homeandaway.hsbc.com is linked for international privileges. pipeline/fetcher.py may_fetch matches official hosts exactly after stripping www, not by suffix, so those hosts were not fetched. robots.txt disallows all PDFs, including fees, product terms, rewards catalogues and the official-host Live+ welcome-offer PDF. listing_complete is false because of those unread off-domain offer hosts and disallowed PDFs. Recipes: ph-hsbc-cards.json and ph-hsbc-offers.json.
